subtitle: Tonal Color Transform
tagline: Seven repeatable voice colours, each combining pitch, formant, spectral balance, and texture, shaped with one TRANSFORM control.

body.lead: TB Colorizer changes the character of a voice in one step. Each colour combines pitch, formant, spectral balance, and texture processing into a fixed tonal identity, so you do not have to build a chain of EQ, pitch shifting, formant processing, and distortion.

body.p: Pick a colour, then set how far the voice moves toward it with `TRANSFORM`. Pink and Blue give familiar higher and lower voice transformations; the other five colours are creative directions for dialogue, singing, streaming, and sound design.

note.text: TB Colorizer is a sound-design tool. It is not voice cloning and does not recreate a specific person's voice.

ul: Seven colours: Pink, Blue, Green, Yellow, Red, Black, and White
TRANSFORM blends from the source (0%) to the full colour (100%)
Factory and user presets, with undo and redo
Works on dialogue, singing, streaming, and sound effects

note.title: About this manual
text: This manual describes TB Colorizer 2.3.1 for Windows (VST3). The current macOS build is version 1.0.3 and may differ from the descriptions here.

ol: Insert TB Colorizer on a vocal or dialogue track.
Click a colour button. Start with `PINK` for a higher voice or `BLUE` for a lower one.
Turn `TRANSFORM` to set the amount: 0% is the original source, 100% is the full colour.
Try the other colours on the same passage and keep the one that fits the part.
Save the result as a user preset if you want to reuse it.

rows: Previous and next preset, the preset list (CUSTOM appears after you edit a preset), Save, Undo, and Redo.
Seven buttons that select the colour. The active colour is marked.
How strongly the chosen colour reshapes the signal.
0% SOURCE / 100% COLOR shows how TRANSFORM blends between the original voice and the colour.
Pink, Blue, Green, Yellow, Red, Black, White
Chooses the tonal identity. Each colour combines its own pitch, formant, spectral, and texture settings.
Amount of transformation. 0% keeps the source; 100% applies the full colour.
Five creative directions for dialogue, singing, streaming, and sound design. Audition each on your own material; their character depends strongly on the source.

tip.text: Lower TRANSFORM to keep more of the original voice; raise it toward 100% for the strongest character.

body.p: Use the arrows to step through presets, or open the list to choose a factory or user preset. Init loads the starting state. Save stores the current colour and TRANSFORM setting as a .tbcolorizerpreset file in the User folder. Undo and Redo step through recent changes.

rows: Lower TRANSFORM, or try a different colour. Clean, dry recordings give the most natural results.
The level changed after choosing a colour.
Some colours change the spectral balance; match the level with your DAW's fader before comparing.
